name: Kinari Soba
description: A quiet, serene food-and-drink theme for a small hand-cut soba house. Buckwheat grey, pale grey-green and ink, with one muted husk-green accent used only for large type and small marks. The name and the menu run in vertical type down a pale grey-green rail on the right edge (a compact bar with a menu button on phones). The home page is a bento of square tiles in hairline seiro-tray frames: a soft watercolour of a tray of soba, the name and a short line, today's note (what is sold out for today), the hours with today's row marked from the site's timezone, a watercolour buckwheat sprig and the stone mill; then the menu as four square trays (cold, warm, the season, sake and small plates) with tabular prices, a wide watercolour of the buckwheat field with the morning's three steps, and the journal as square cards. The footer is a watercolour street map beside the address card with the noren line. With Menu, The mill, Journal, Newsletter and Visit. The hours, today's note and the menu are synced patterns, edited once. Hero and decoration are vector watercolours; the dish photographs are raster. Kaisei HarunoUmi over Murecho. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.

summary.zh-TW: 安靜清雅的手打蕎麥麵店網站，以便當格式的方形竹篩菜單、今日售完公告與水彩插畫呈現。
summary.en: A quiet site for a small hand-cut soba house, with a bento of seiro trays, today's sold-out note and watercolours.
summary.ja: 小さな手打ちそば屋のための静かなサイト。せいろの弁当型メニュー、本日の売り切れ案内、水彩画付き。
summary.fr: Un site calme pour un petit restaurant de soba faits main, avec un menu en plateaux, la note du jour et des aquarelles.
summary.de: Eine ruhige Website für ein kleines Soba-Lokal mit handgeschnittenen Nudeln, Tablett-Menü, Tagesnotiz und Aquarellen.

visual: watercolour (vector SVG hero, buckwheat sprig, stone mill, field and street map, generated with Grok Build); dish photographs raster
deviation: none for the header, footer and layout codes (H11 / F6 / L6 as planned). Added colours: paper #F6F6F2 for the tray tiles, deep husk #4E5A3F for links and small labels (6.2:1 on buckwheat, 5.3:1 on grey-green, 6.8:1 on paper), quiet grey #565B52 for secondary text (5.9:1 / 5.1:1 / 6.4:1) and hairline #BFC4B6 for the tray frames and rules only. The planned muted husk green #6E7A5C (3.9:1 buckwheat, 3.3:1 grey-green, 4.2:1 paper) is used only for large type and marks (the slat line before every label, step numerals, morning times, today's bar and dot). Ink text 13.0:1 on buckwheat, 11.1:1 on grey-green, 14.1:1 on paper. Hero and decorations are vector watercolours per the 2026-10-14 visual-style rule.
